title: Mayor Earl Cabell, brother Charles Cabell of CIA, motorcade route

tellings.quote: Um the mayor of Dallas was a guy named Earl Cabel. Yeah. And um his his brother Charles was Dallas's number two at the CIA on the Bay of Pigs.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points out that in the early 1960s the mayor of Dallas, Texas, was a man named Earl Cabell. He says Earl's brother, Charles Cabell, held a senior role at the CIA, the US spy agency, tied to the Bay of Pigs, the failed 1961 US-backed invasion of Cuba. Michels raises it in connection with the route of President Kennedy's motorcade through Dallas in 1963, suggesting a link between the city's leadership and the agency.
